dataset.rare_scope: All raw cards retained; known manual attributes, including brand/model, are retained for rare categories. Unsupported attributes are not invented.

ner_scope: Production default: first 40000 shuffled-by-id cards, at most 12000 text examples per perceptron training pass, five epochs.

functional_verification.scope: Functional checks only; every source card was used for final production training, so this is not held-out F1.

scope: Final production training includes every raw source offer. Previous TEST/TEST_NEW are part of training and are no longer independent evaluation sets.

reproduce.prepare: uv run --with pyarrow==26.0.0 --with pyyaml python docs/full-catalog-prepare.py RAW_DIR PREPARED_DIR
reproduce.train: GOLD=partial LLM_MODE=off LEARN_WORKERS=3 RUBY_YJIT_ENABLE=1 ruby bin/rails runner script/train_isolated.rb PREPARED_DIR/data/all.jsonl NEW_MODELS_DIR - PREPARED_DIR/config
reproduce.install: Copy the selected generated artifacts into config only after checking the new model in isolation.
